lyrics:
[Intro: arpeggiated synth bass, disco hi-hat, string swell]

[Verse 1: dramatic low female voice]
They said wait until it's dark
They said glitter needs a night
I have waited long enough
Hang it up, turn on the light

[Chorus: full Italo-disco groove, long falling melody]
Disco at noon
Mirrorball in the daylight
Diamonds on the water, shadows on the wall
Sequins in the sun and nowhere to be at all
I don't need the moon
Disco at noon

[Verse 2: voice closer, guitar chopping]
I was young, I stayed out late
Now I'm up before the heat
Same two feet, same silver shoes
Different hour, same old beat

[Chorus: full Italo-disco groove, long falling melody]
Disco at noon
Mirrorball in the daylight
Diamonds on the water, shadows on the wall
Sequins in the sun and nowhere to be at all
I don't need the moon
Disco at noon

[Instrumental: synth solo over the arpeggio]

[Bridge: beat thins, voice and strings]
Why save it? Why save it?
The light is here. I'm here.

[Final Chorus: everything in, backing voices answering]
Disco at noon
Mirrorball in the daylight
Diamonds on the water, shadows on the wall
Sequins in the sun and nowhere to be at all
I don't need the moon
Disco at noon

[Outro: arpeggio and strings fade]
